note: Category scope for this project. `seed_series` are series tickers that appear IN THE OFFICIAL KALSHI FEE SCHEDULE (https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf) and are therefore confirmed to exist. Keyword matching is a FALLBACK only and every match records which basis matched it (basis=seed|keyword) so nothing is presented as confirmed when it is not. All live values are fetched from the API by scripts/collect.py; nothing about live prices/volumes is stored here. F-66 adds official_categories/official_tags per topic: the documented GET /series filters that the exchange itself uses for the same topic. A row matched that way is still labelled basis=seed or keyword (the schema is unchanged) and carries category_matched_by=official plus the official categories/tags it matched.

categories.label: Gas Prices
categories.official_note: Series returned by GET /series with these exact, case-sensitive filter values are in this topic (basis=official). Verified live on 2026-11-21: ?category=Elections and ?category=Entertainment and ?tags=Golf all return series; ?category=Entertainment is how Kalshi files the Emmys, SAG Awards, CMA Awards and Billboard series that the fee-schedule seed list mostly misses.
categories.official_mapping_note: No official filter isolates RETAIL gasoline: ?tags=Oil & Gas returns WTI crude, heating oil and Pyth WTI futures (verified 2026-11-21), and ?category=Economics returns CPI/GDP/jobs. Gas therefore stays on the fee-schedule AAA series plus the gasoline keyword. ?tags=Golf and ?category=Crypto and ?category=Entertainment are verified narrow filters (134/321/2,631 series); the same check is what ruled out Oil & Gas for gasoline.
